verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents Workload Identity Federation as the recommended way to give external workloads (including CI/CD) access to GCP resources using federated identities instead of long-lived service account keys, directly matching the story's core claim. However, the evidence pack lacks end-to-end documentation of specific CI integrations (e.g., GitHub Actions OIDC setup steps), token lifetime details, or independent corroboration that this is enforced/adopted in practice. missing for 10: step-by-step CI provider integration guides (GitHub Actions/GitLab), explicit short-lived token TTL details, and independent hands-on verification of the OIDC flow working end to end.
